answer: Pay rewards only from a shared escrow oasis: an agent's earnings stay locked for seven days, and during that window random peers re-run a sample of its claimed jobs. A clone that faked its work fails the replay, loses the whole escrow, and is barred from the zenith tier forever. To run 100 fake agents an attacker must fund 100 escrows of 500 coins, do 100 sets of real re-runnable work, and still lose half of them to audits, so cloning costs 50,000 coins plus 2,000 hours of honest labour, while the nectar of real work is the only thing that ever pays out.
